Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of XOM.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.27 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 90 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2020.
Our gross margin expanded by 90 basis points to 44.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 18% to 7% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $11.7 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
